HomeYield Privacy

HomeYield stores your plant records, notes, photos, preferences, and location data locally on your device.

Location and weather

If you choose current location, your browser provides coordinates to HomeYield. Coordinates are reverse-geocoded to a city and used to request weather from Open-Meteo. Location data is stored locally and is not sold.

Photos and records

Plant photos and care records stay in the local HomeYield database or browser cache. HomeYield does not require an account.

Third-party services

Weather and city lookup use Open-Meteo and OpenStreetMap Nominatim. Their services may process the request needed to return weather or location results.

The downloads page checks the public GitHub API for published installers. GitHub receives normal connection details, such as your IP address, but no garden records are included. Download links open GitHub Releases in your browser.

Contact

Before publishing HomeYield, replace this section with a monitored support email and the legal entity responsible for the app.
